statement: INSERT INTO workspace.mlpab8d9f43.recs971bf6 WITH u AS (SELECT user_id, CAST(e1 AS DOUBLE) e1, CAST(e2 AS DOUBLE) e2, CAST(e3 AS DOUBLE) e3, CAST(e4 AS DOUBLE) e4, CAST(e5 AS DOUBLE) e5, CAST(e6 AS DOUBLE) e6, CAST(e7 AS DOUBLE) e7, CAST(e8 AS DOUBLE) e8 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab8d9f43/raw/user_embeddings.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), i AS (SELECT item_id, CAST(e1 AS DOUBLE) e1, CAST(e2 AS DOUBLE) e2, CAST(e3 AS DOUBLE) e3, CAST(e4 AS DOUBLE) e4, CAST(e5 AS DOUBLE) e5, CAST(e6 AS DOUBLE) e6, CAST(e7 AS DOUBLE) e7, CAST(e8 AS DOUBLE) e8 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab8d9f43/raw/item_embeddings.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), inter AS (SELECT user_id, item_id FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab8d9f43/raw/interactions.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), ranked AS (SELECT u.user_id, i.item_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) DESC, i.item_id ASC) AS rnk FROM u CROSS JOIN i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inter x WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id)) SELECT concat(user_id, '#', rnk) AS rec_id, user_id, CAST(rnk AS INT) AS `rank`, item_id FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5
